item.title: Madonna Returns to Billboard’s Dance Charts With ‘I Feel So Free’
item.description:
[Upbeat music plays in the background]
Host: "Welcome to our music update. We've got some exciting news for all you Madonna fans out there. Her latest single, 'I Feel So Free', has just debuted on four Billboard charts, including a number one spot on the Dance Digital Song Sales tally. This is the first song released from her upcoming album, 'Confessions II', which is set to drop on July 3rd via Warner Records.
[Short music clip from "I Feel So Free" plays]
Host: "Not only did 'I Feel So Free' top the Dance Digital Song Sales chart, but it also entered the Digital Song Sales chart at number 6, making it Madonna's 10th top 10 on that chart. And if that's not enough, it also debuted on the Hot Dance/Pop Songs chart at number 12 and the Dance/Mix Show Airplay chart at number 14.
[Short music clip from "Like a Prayer" plays]
Host: "Interestingly, DJ Josh Fawaz's cover of Madonna's classic hit 'Like a Prayer' is also climbing the charts, reaching number 3 on Dance Digital Song Sales and number 19 on Digital Song Sales.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "These chart-topping debuts are a testament to Madonna's enduring legacy in the music industry. We can't wait to see what's next for the Queen of Pop. That's all for today's music update. Thanks for tuning in!"
[Upbeat music continues to play until the end of the podcast]
